name: Daily Fuel Consumption
query:
SELECT
    fl.fuel_date AS "Date:Date:110",
    ROUND(SUM(fl.quantity_litres), 2) AS "Total Quantity (L):Float:140",
    ROUND(SUM(fl.total_fuel_cost), 2) AS "Total Fuel Cost:Currency:150",
    COUNT(fl.name) AS "Approved Entries:Int:120",
    ROUND(SUM(fl.total_fuel_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(fl.quantity_litres), 0), 2) AS "Avg Rate per Litre:Currency:140"
FROM `tabFuel Log` fl
WHERE fl.is_test_record = 0
  AND fl.approval_status = 'Approved'
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fl.fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fl.fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR fl.vehicle = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(driver)s IS NULL OR %(driver)s = '' OR fl.driver = %(driver)s)
  AND (%(mine_site)s IS NULL OR %(mine_site)s = '' OR fl.mine_site = %(mine_site)s)
GROUP BY fl.fuel_date
ORDER BY fl.fuel_date DESC

name: Vehicle-wise Fuel Consumption
query:
SELECT
    fl.vehicle AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:140",
    fl.fuel_source AS "Fuel Source:Data:120",
    ROUND(SUM(fl.quantity_litres), 2) AS "Total Quantity (L):Float:140",
    ROUND(SUM(fl.total_fuel_cost), 2) AS "Total Cost:Currency:140",
    SUM(IFNULL(fl.distance_travelled_km, 0)) AS "Total Distance (KM):Int:150",
    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(fl.distance_travelled_km, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(fl.distance_travelled_km, 0) > 0 THEN fl.quantity_litres ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS "Avg Interval KM/L:Float:150",
    COUNT(fl.name) AS "Refuel Count:Int:100"
FROM `tabFuel Log` fl
WHERE fl.is_test_record = 0
  AND fl.approval_status = 'Approved'
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fl.fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fl.fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR fl.vehicle = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(driver)s IS NULL OR %(driver)s = '' OR fl.driver = %(driver)s)
  AND (%(mine_site)s IS NULL OR %(mine_site)s = '' OR fl.mine_site = %(mine_site)s)
GROUP BY fl.vehicle, fl.fuel_source
ORDER BY fl.vehicle ASC

    COUNT(fl.name) AS "Approved Entries:Int:120"

name: Daily Operational Expense
query:
SELECT
    oe.expense_date AS "Date:Date:110",
    COUNT(oe.name) AS "Expense Count:Int:110",
    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(oe.amount, 0)), 2) AS "Total Amount:Currency:130",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN oe.approval_status = 'Approved' THEN IFNULL(oe.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS "Approved Amount:Currency:130",
    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(oe.posted_amount, 0)), 2) AS "Posted Amount:Currency:130",
    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(oe.paid_amount, 0)), 2) AS "Paid Amount:Currency:130"
FROM `tabOperational Expense` oe
WHERE (oe.is_test_record = 0 OR oe.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR oe.expense_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR oe.expense_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR oe.vehicle = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(expense_category)s IS NULL OR %(expense_category)s = '' OR oe.expense_category = %(expense_category)s)
  AND (%(mine_site)s IS NULL OR %(mine_site)s = '' OR oe.mine_site = %(mine_site)s)
  AND (%(approval_status)s IS NULL OR %(approval_status)s = '' OR oe.approval_status = %(approval_status)s)
  AND (%(accounting_status)s IS NULL OR %(accounting_status)s = '' OR oe.accounting_status = %(accounting_status)s)
GROUP BY oe.expense_date
ORDER BY oe.expense_date DESC

    ROUND(COALESCE(ir.warehouse_reorder_qty, NULLIF(i.min_order_qty, 0), 0), 2) AS "Reorder Qty:Float:100",
    ROUND(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(ir.warehouse_reorder_level, NULLIF(i.safety_stock, 0), 0) - IFNULL(b.actual_qty, 0)), 2) AS "Shortage Qty:Float:100",
    COALESCE(i.custom_preferred_supplier, '-') AS "Preferred Supplier:Link/Supplier:140",
    CASE
        WHEN IFNULL(b.actual_qty, 0) <= 0 THEN 'Critical Low'
        WHEN IFNULL(b.actual_qty, 0) <= COALESCE(ir.warehouse_reorder_level, NULLIF(i.safety_stock, 0), 0) THEN 'Reorder Needed'
        ELSE 'Adequate'
    END AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM `tabBin` b
JOIN `tabItem` i ON b.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN `tabItem Reorder` ir ON ir.parent = i.name AND ir.warehouse = b.warehouse
WHERE (i.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR i.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (i.disabled = 0)
  AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR %(warehouse)s = '' OR b.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
  AND (%(item_group)s IS NULL OR %(item_group)s = '' OR i.item_group = %(item_group)s)
  AND (%(preferred_supplier)s IS NULL OR %(preferred_supplier)s = '' OR i.custom_preferred_supplier = %(preferred_supplier)s)
  AND (
      IFNULL(b.actual_qty, 0) <= COALESCE(ir.warehouse_reorder_level, NULLIF(i.safety_stock, 0), 0)
      OR %(show_all)s = '1'
  )

name: Stock Movement History
query:
SELECT
    sle.posting_date AS "Date:Date:100",
    sle.posting_time AS "Time:Time:90",
    CASE
        WHEN sle.is_cancelled = 0 THEN 'Active'
        WHEN sle.is_cancelled = 1 AND (
            (se.stock_entry_type = 'Material Issue' AND sle.actual_qty > 0)
            OR (se.stock_entry_type IN ('Material Receipt', 'Receive at Site') AND sle.actual_qty < 0)
            OR (sle.creation > (SELECT MIN(s2.creation) FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` s2 WHERE s2.voucher_no = sle.voucher_no AND s2.voucher_detail_no = sle.voucher_detail_no))
        ) THEN 'Cancelled (Reversal)'
        WHEN sle.is_cancelled = 1 THEN 'Cancelled (Original)'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END AS "Status:Data:140",
    sle.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:130",
    i.item_name AS "Part Name:Data:160",
    sle.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:140",
    sle.voucher_type AS "Voucher Type:Data:120",
    sle.voucher_no AS "Voucher No:Dynamic Link/voucher_type:140",
    ROUND(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty > 0 THEN sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END, 2) AS "In Qty:Float:90",
    ROUND(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty < 0 THEN ABS(sle.actual_qty) ELSE 0 END, 2) AS "Out Qty:Float:90",
    ROUND(sle.qty_after_transaction, 2) AS "Balance Qty:Float:100",
    ROUND(sle.valuation_rate, 2) AS "Valuation Rate:Currency:110",
    ROUND(sle.stock_value_difference, 2) AS "Value Diff:Currency:110",
    COALESCE(se.custom_vehicle, '-') AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:120",
    COALESCE(se.custom_vehicle_breakdown, '-') AS "Breakdown:Link/Vehicle Breakdown:140"
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
JOIN `tabItem` i ON sle.item_code = i.name
LEFT JOIN `tabStock Entry` se ON sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND sle.voucher_no = se.name
LEFT JOIN `tabVehicle Breakdown` vb ON se.custom_vehicle_breakdown = vb.name
LEFT JOIN `tabVehicle` v ON se.custom_vehicle = v.name
WHERE (i.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR i.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (vb.is_test_record = 0 OR vb.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(include_cancelled)s = '1' OR sle.is_cancelled = 0)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR sle.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR %(warehouse)s = '' OR sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
  AND (%(item_code)s IS NULL OR %(item_code)s = '' OR sle.item_code = %(item_code)s)
  AND (%(voucher_type)s IS NULL OR %(voucher_type)s = '' OR sle.voucher_type = %(voucher_type)s)
ORDER BY sle.posting_datetime DESC, sle.creation DESC

    CASE

        ELSE DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) 
    END AS "Days Remaining:Int:110",
    CASE
        WHEN v.end_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
        WHEN v.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'
        ELSE 'Valid'
    END AS "Coverage Status:Data:120",

    COALESCE(vip.insured_declared_value, 0.0) AS "IDV:Currency:120",
    v.insurance_policy_doc AS "Policy Doc:Attach:110"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN field = 'warning_window_days' THEN value END), 30) AS UNSIGNED) AS warning_window FROM tabSingles WHERE doctype = 'Fleet Settings') fs
LEFT JOIN `tabVehicle Insurance Policy` vip ON vip.vehicle = v.name 
    AND vip.policy_status = 'Active' 
    AND (v.policy_no IS NULL OR vip.policy_no = v.policy_no)
WHERE (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR v.name = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(insurance_company)s IS NULL OR %(insurance_company)s = '' OR v.insurance_company = %(insurance_company)s)
  AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR %(status)s = '' OR (
        CASE
            WHEN v.end_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
            WHEN v.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'

  ) = %(status)s)

        ELSE 'Active'

    CASE

        ELSE 'Initiate Renewal'
    END AS "Action Required:Data:180"

CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN field = 'warning_window_days' THEN value END), 30) AS UNSIGNED) AS warning_window FROM tabSingles WHERE doctype = 'Fleet Settings') fs
WHERE (vip.is_test_record = 0 OR vip.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND vip.policy_status IN ('Active', 'Expired')
  AND (vip.end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL fs.warning_window DAY))
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR vip.vehicle = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(insurance_company)s IS NULL OR %(insurance_company)s = '' OR vip.insurance_company = %(insurance_company)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR vip.end_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR vip.end_date <= %(to_date)s)

name: Vehicle Document Expiry Report
query:
SELECT
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
    v.make AS "Make:Data:100",
    v.model AS "Model:Data:120",
    CASE
        WHEN v.end_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
        WHEN v.end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'
        ELSE 'Valid'
    END AS "Insurance Status:Data:120",
    v.end_date AS "Insurance Expiry:Date:100",

    CASE
        WHEN v.fitness_expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
        WHEN v.fitness_expiry_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(v.fitness_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'
        ELSE 'Valid'
    END AS "Fitness Status:Data:120",
    v.fitness_expiry_date AS "Fitness Expiry:Date:100",

    CASE
        WHEN v.puc_expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
        WHEN v.puc_expiry_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(v.puc_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'
        ELSE 'Valid'
    END AS "PUC Status:Data:120",
    v.puc_expiry_date AS "PUC Expiry:Date:100",

    CASE
        WHEN v.road_tax_expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
        WHEN v.road_tax_expiry_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(v.road_tax_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'
        ELSE 'Valid'
    END AS "Road Tax Status:Data:120",
    v.road_tax_expiry_date AS "Road Tax Expiry:Date:100",

    CASE
        WHEN v.permit_expiry_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Recorded'
        WHEN v.permit_expiry_date < CURDATE() THEN 'Expired'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(v.permit_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window THEN 'Expiring Soon'
        ELSE 'Valid'
    END AS "Permit Status:Data:120",
    v.permit_expiry_date AS "Permit Expiry:Date:100",

    CASE
        WHEN (v.end_date < CURDATE() OR v.fitness_expiry_date < CURDATE() OR v.puc_expiry_date < CURDATE() OR v.road_tax_expiry_date < CURDATE() OR v.permit_expiry_date < CURDATE())
            THEN 'Non-Compliant (Expired Documents)'
        WHEN (DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window OR DATEDIFF(v.fitness_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window OR DATEDIFF(v.puc_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window OR DATEDIFF(v.road_tax_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window OR DATEDIFF(v.permit_expiry_date, CURDATE()) <= fs.warning_window)
            THEN 'Attention Needed (Expiring Soon)'
        WHEN (v.end_date IS NOT NULL AND v.fitness_expiry_date IS NOT NULL)
            THEN 'Fully Compliant'
        ELSE 'Incomplete Documentation'
    END AS "Overall Compliance:Data:160"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN field = 'warning_window_days' THEN value END), 30) AS UNSIGNED) AS warning_window FROM tabSingles WHERE doctype = 'Fleet Settings') fs
WHERE (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR v.name = %(vehicle)s)
ORDER BY v.name ASC

name: Upcoming Renewals
query:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
        'Insurance' AS "Document Type:Data:130",
        COALESCE(v.policy_no, '-') AS "Reference No:Data:140",

        DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) AS "Days Remaining:Int:110",
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'Critical (<= 7 Days)'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(v.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 15 THEN 'High (<= 15 Days)'
            ELSE 'Expiring Within Warning Window'
        END AS "Urgency:Data:130",
        'Renew Insurance Policy' AS "Action Required:Data:160",
        v.is_test_record
    FROM `tabVehicle` v
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN field = 'warning_window_days' THEN value END), 30) AS UNSIGNED) AS warning_window FROM tabSingles WHERE doctype = 'Fleet Settings') fs
    WHERE v.end_date IS NOT NULL AND v.end_date >= CURDATE() AND v.end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL fs.warning_window DAY)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
        'Fitness Certificate' AS "Document Type:Data:130",
        'FC' AS "Reference No:Data:140",
        v.fitness_expiry_date AS "Expiry Date:Date:100",

    FROM `tabVehicle` v
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN field = 'warning_window_days' THEN value END), 30) AS UNSIGNED) AS warning_window FROM tabSingles WHERE doctype = 'Fleet Settings') fs
    WHERE v.fitness_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND v.fitness_expiry_date >= CURDATE() AND v.fitness_expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL fs.warning_window DAY)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
        'PUC Certificate' AS "Document Type:Data:130",
        'PUC' AS "Reference No:Data:140",
        v.puc_expiry_date AS "Expiry Date:Date:100",

name: Trip-wise Revenue and Profitability
query:
SELECT
    mt.name AS "Trip ID:Link/Mining Trip:140",
    mt.dispatch_date_time AS "Dispatch Date:Datetime:140",
    mt.vehicle AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:120",
    mt.driver AS "Driver:Link/Driver:130",
    mt.mine_site AS "Mine Site:Link/Mine Site:140",
    COALESCE(ms.client, '-') AS "Client:Link/Customer:130",
    COALESCE(mt.net_weight_tons, 0.0) AS "Net Tons:Float:90",
    mt.trip_status AS "Trip Status:Data:100",
    COALESCE(mt.billing_status, 'Unbilled') AS "Billing Status:Data:110",
    COALESCE(mt.rate_per_ton, 0.0) AS "Indicative Rate:Currency:110",
    CASE 
        WHEN mt.trip_status IN ('Approved', 'Delivered') AND mt.rate_per_ton > 0 
        THEN ROUND(COALESCE(mt.net_weight_tons, 0.0) * mt.rate_per_ton, 2)
        ELSE 0.0 
    END AS "Estimated Revenue:Currency:130",
    COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) AS "Invoiced Revenue:Currency:130",
    COALESCE(opex.direct_opex, 0.0) AS "Direct Trip OpEx:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(bkd.direct_repair, 0.0) AS "Direct Repair Cost:Currency:120",
    (COALESCE(opex.direct_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(bkd.direct_repair, 0.0)) AS "Total Direct Cost:Currency:120",
    (COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) - (COALESCE(opex.direct_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(bkd.direct_repair, 0.0))) AS "Contribution:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(rev.invoice_names, mt.sales_invoice, '-') AS "Sales Invoice:Data:160"
FROM `tabMining Trip` mt
LEFT JOIN `tabMine Site` ms ON ms.name = mt.mine_site
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        trip_id,
        SUM(inv_amt) AS invoiced_revenue,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT inv_name ORDER BY inv_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS invoice_names
    FROM (
        -- Header-level trip link (when items do NOT have specific item-level trip link)
        SELECT 
            si.custom_mining_trip AS trip_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(si.base_grand_total) ELSE si.base_grand_total END AS inv_amt,
            si.name AS inv_name
        FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND si.custom_mining_trip IS NOT NULL AND si.custom_mining_trip != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii_sub 
              WHERE sii_sub.parent = si.name AND sii_sub.custom_mining_trip IS NOT NULL AND sii_sub.custom_mining_trip != ''
          )
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Item-level trip link (multi-trip invoices or line-level trip attribution)
        SELECT 
            sii.custom_mining_trip AS trip_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(sii.base_net_amount) ELSE sii.base_net_amount END AS inv_amt,
            si.name AS inv_name
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND sii.custom_mining_trip IS NOT NULL AND sii.custom_mining_trip != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
    ) trip_invoices
    GROUP BY trip_id
) rev ON rev.trip_id = mt.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT mining_trip, SUM(posted_amount) AS direct_opex
    FROM `tabOperational Expense`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved' 
      AND accounting_status = 'Posted' 
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND mining_trip IS NOT NULL
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
    GROUP BY mining_trip
) opex ON opex.mining_trip = mt.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT related_trip, SUM(total_repair_cost) AS direct_repair
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown`
    WHERE resolution_type != 'Rejected'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND related_trip IS NOT NULL
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
    GROUP BY related_trip
) bkd ON bkd.related_trip = mt.name
WHERE (mt.is_test_record = 0 OR mt.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR mt.vehicle = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(mine_site)s IS NULL OR %(mine_site)s = '' OR mt.mine_site = %(mine_site)s)
  AND (%(trip_status)s IS NULL OR %(trip_status)s = '' OR mt.trip_status = %(trip_status)s)
  AND (%(billing_status)s IS NULL OR %(billing_status)s = '' OR mt.billing_status = %(billing_status)s)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR DATE(mt.dispatch_date_time) >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR DATE(mt.dispatch_date_time) <= %(to_date)s)
ORDER BY mt.dispatch_date_time DESC

name: Vehicle-wise Revenue and Profitability
query:
SELECT
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
    v.make AS "Make:Data:100",
    v.model AS "Model:Data:110",
    COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) AS "Trips Count:Int:90",
    COALESCE(t.total_tons, 0.0) AS "Total Tons:Float:100",
    COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) AS "Invoiced Revenue:Currency:130",
    COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) AS "Fuel Cost:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(maint.parts_cost, 0.0) AS "Parts Cost:Currency:110",
    COALESCE(maint.labour_cost, 0.0) AS "Labour Cost:Currency:110",
    COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) AS "Maintenance Cost:Currency:130",
    COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) AS "Direct OpEx:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0) AS "Insurance:Currency:110",
    (COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0)) AS "Total Operating Cost:Currency:140",
    (COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) - (COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0))) AS "Net Contribution:Currency:130",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(((COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) - (COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0))) / rev.invoiced_revenue) * 100.0, 2)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS "Operating Margin %%:Percent:110"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, COUNT(name) AS trip_count, SUM(COALESCE(net_weight_tons, 0.0)) AS total_tons
    FROM `tabMining Trip`
    WHERE (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR DATE(dispatch_date_time) >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR DATE(dispatch_date_time) <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) t ON t.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        vehicle_id,
        SUM(inv_amt) AS invoiced_revenue
    FROM (
        -- Header-level vehicle link (when items do NOT have specific item-level vehicle link)
        SELECT 
            si.custom_vehicle AS vehicle_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(si.base_grand_total) ELSE si.base_grand_total END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND si.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND si.custom_vehicle != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
          AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
          AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii_sub 
              WHERE sii_sub.parent = si.name AND sii_sub.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND sii_sub.custom_vehicle != ''
          )
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Item-level vehicle link (multi-vehicle invoices or line-level vehicle attribution)
        SELECT 
            sii.custom_vehicle AS vehicle_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(sii.base_net_amount) ELSE sii.base_net_amount END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND sii.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND sii.custom_vehicle != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
          AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
          AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
    ) veh_invoices
    GROUP BY vehicle_id
) rev ON rev.vehicle_id = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(total_fuel_cost) AS fuel_cost
    FROM `tabFuel Log`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) fuel ON fuel.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(parts_cost) AS parts_cost, SUM(labour_cost) AS labour_cost, SUM(total_repair_cost) AS total_maint
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown`
    WHERE resolution_type != 'Rejected'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) maint ON maint.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(posted_amount) AS vehicle_opex
    FROM `tabOperational Expense`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND accounting_status = 'Posted'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND vehicle IS NOT NULL
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR expense_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR expense_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) opex ON opex.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(premium_amount) AS premium
    FROM `tabVehicle Insurance Policy`
    WHERE policy_status = 'Active'
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
    GROUP BY vehicle

WHERE (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR v.name = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(make)s IS NULL OR %(make)s = '' OR v.make = %(make)s)
ORDER BY v.name ASC

        -- Item-level site link (multi-site invoices or line-level site attribution)
        SELECT 
            sii.custom_mine_site AS site_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(sii.base_net_amount) ELSE sii.base_net_amount END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND sii.custom_mine_site IS NOT NULL AND sii.custom_mine_site != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
          AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
          AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
    ) site_invoices
    GROUP BY site_id
) rev ON rev.site_id = ms.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT mine_site, SUM(total_fuel_cost) AS fuel_cost
    FROM `tabFuel Log`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY mine_site
) fuel ON fuel.mine_site = ms.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT mine_site, SUM(total_repair_cost) AS repair_cost
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown`
    WHERE resolution_type != 'Rejected'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY mine_site
) bkd ON bkd.mine_site = ms.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT mine_site, SUM(posted_amount) AS site_opex
    FROM `tabOperational Expense`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND accounting_status = 'Posted'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND mine_site IS NOT NULL
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR expense_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR expense_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY mine_site
) opex ON opex.mine_site = ms.name
WHERE (ms.is_test_record = 0 OR ms.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(mine_site)s IS NULL OR %(mine_site)s = '' OR ms.name = %(mine_site)s)
  AND (%(customer)s IS NULL OR %(customer)s = '' OR ms.client = %(customer)s)
ORDER BY ms.name ASC

name: Vehicle Operating Cost Analysis
query:
SELECT
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
    v.make AS "Make:Data:100",
    v.model AS "Model:Data:110",
    COALESCE(odo.distance_km, 0) AS "Distance Run (KM):Int:110",
    COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) AS "Fuel Cost:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(maint.parts_cost, 0.0) AS "Parts Cost:Currency:110",
    COALESCE(maint.labour_cost, 0.0) AS "Labour Cost:Currency:110",
    COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) AS "Direct OpEx:Currency:110",
    COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0) AS "Insurance:Currency:110",
    (COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.parts_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.labour_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0)) AS "Total Vehicle Cost:Currency:140",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(odo.distance_km, 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND((COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.parts_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.labour_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) + COALESCE(ins.premium, 0.0)) / odo.distance_km, 2)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS "Cost per KM:Currency:110"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
LEFT JOIN (

    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'

      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)

) odo ON odo.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(total_fuel_cost) AS fuel_cost

    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) fuel ON fuel.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(parts_cost) AS parts_cost, SUM(labour_cost) AS labour_cost
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown`
    WHERE resolution_type != 'Rejected'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)

      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) maint ON maint.vehicle = v.name

    SELECT vehicle, SUM(posted_amount) AS vehicle_opex

    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND accounting_status = 'Posted'

      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR expense_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR expense_date <= %(to_date)s)

name: Revenue vs Cost Analysis
query:
SELECT
    'Vehicle' AS "Entity Type:Data:100",
    v.name AS "Entity Name:Data:140",
    COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) AS "Invoiced Revenue:Currency:130",
    COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) AS "Fuel Cost:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) AS "Maintenance Cost:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) AS "Operational Expenses:Currency:120",
    (COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0)) AS "Total Identifiable Cost:Currency:140",
    (COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) - (COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0))) AS "Operating Margin / Profit:Currency:140",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(((COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0)) / rev.invoiced_revenue) * 100.0, 2)
        ELSE 0.0
    END AS "Cost-to-Revenue Ratio %%:Percent:130"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        vehicle_id,
        SUM(inv_amt) AS invoiced_revenue
    FROM (
        -- Header-level vehicle link (when items do NOT have specific item-level vehicle link)
        SELECT 
            si.custom_vehicle AS vehicle_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(si.base_grand_total) ELSE si.base_grand_total END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice` si

          AND si.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND si.custom_vehicle != ''

          AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii_sub 
              WHERE sii_sub.parent = si.name AND sii_sub.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND sii_sub.custom_vehicle != ''
          )
        
        UNION ALL
        
        -- Item-level vehicle link (multi-vehicle invoices or line-level vehicle attribution)
        SELECT 
            sii.custom_vehicle AS vehicle_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(sii.base_net_amount) ELSE sii.base_net_amount END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND sii.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND sii.custom_vehicle != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
          AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
          AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
    ) veh_invoices
    GROUP BY vehicle_id
) rev ON rev.vehicle_id = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(total_fuel_cost) AS fuel_cost
    FROM `tabFuel Log`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) fuel ON fuel.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(total_repair_cost) AS total_maint
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown`
    WHERE resolution_type != 'Rejected'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR DATE(breakdown_datetime) <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) maint ON maint.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT vehicle, SUM(posted_amount) AS vehicle_opex
    FROM `tabOperational Expense`
    WHERE approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND accounting_status = 'Posted'
      AND docstatus != 2
      AND vehicle IS NOT NULL
      AND (is_test_record = 0 OR is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR expense_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR expense_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY vehicle
) opex ON opex.vehicle = v.name
WHERE (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR v.name = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) > 0 OR COALESCE(fuel.fuel_cost, 0.0) > 0 OR COALESCE(maint.total_maint, 0.0) > 0 OR COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) > 0)
ORDER BY 8 DESC

name: Fleet Utilization
query:
SELECT
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:140",
    v.make AS "Make:Data:110",
    v.model AS "Model:Data:120",
    v.vehicle_status AS "Status:Data:110",
    COALESCE(v.assigned_driver, '-') AS "Assigned Driver:Link/Driver:140",
    COALESCE(t.total_trips, 0) AS "Total Trips:Int:90",
    COALESCE(t.completed_trips, 0) AS "Delivered Trips:Int:100",
    COALESCE(t.total_tonnage, 0.0) AS "Total Tonnage (Tons):Float:140",
    COALESCE(fl.total_km, 0) AS "Distance Travelled (KM):Int:140",
    COALESCE(fl.total_fuel, 0.0) AS "Fuel Consumed (L):Float:120",
    COALESCE(bkd.total_downtime, 0.0) AS "Downtime (Hours):Float:120",
    CASE 
        WHEN v.vehicle_status = 'On Trip' THEN 'In Operation'
        WHEN v.vehicle_status = 'Active' AND COALESCE(t.total_trips, 0) > 0 THEN 'Utilized'
        WHEN v.vehicle_status IN ('Under Maintenance', 'Breakdown') THEN 'Maintenance / Down'
        WHEN v.vehicle_status = 'Out of Service' THEN 'Out of Service'
        ELSE 'Available / Standby'
    END AS "Utilization State:Data:140"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        mt.vehicle,
        COUNT(mt.name) AS total_trips,
        SUM(CASE WHEN mt.trip_status IN ('Approved', 'Delivered') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_trips,
        SUM(CASE WHEN mt.docstatus = 1 THEN IFNULL(mt.net_weight_tons, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_tonnage
    FROM `tabMining Trip` mt
    WHERE mt.docstatus != 2
      AND (mt.is_test_record = 0 OR mt.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
    GROUP BY mt.vehicle
) t ON t.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        fl_sub.vehicle,
        SUM(IFNULL(fl_sub.distance_travelled_km, 0)) AS total_km,
        SUM(IFNULL(fl_sub.quantity_litres, 0)) AS total_fuel
    FROM `tabFuel Log` fl_sub
    WHERE fl_sub.docstatus = 1
      AND (fl_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR fl_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fl_sub.fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fl_sub.fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY fl_sub.vehicle
) fl ON fl.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        vb_sub.vehicle,
        SUM(IFNULL(vb_sub.downtime_hours, 0)) AS total_downtime
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown` vb_sub
    WHERE vb_sub.docstatus != 2
      AND (vb_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR vb_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR vb_sub.breakdown_datetime >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR vb_sub.breakdown_datetime <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
    GROUP BY vb_sub.vehicle
) bkd ON bkd.vehicle = v.name
WHERE (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR v.name = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(vehicle_status)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle_status)s = '' OR v.vehicle_status = %(vehicle_status)s)
ORDER BY v.name ASC

name: Vehicle Performance Summary
query:
SELECT
    v.name AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:130",
    v.make AS "Make:Data:100",
    v.model AS "Model:Data:110",
    v.vehicle_status AS "Status:Data:100",
    COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) AS "Completed Trips:Int:100",
    COALESCE(t.total_tons, 0.0) AS "Total Tons:Float:100",
    COALESCE(fl.total_litres, 0.0) AS "Fuel Consumed (L):Float:120",
    COALESCE(fl.fuel_cost, 0.0) AS "Fuel Cost:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(fl.avg_kml, 0.0) AS "Avg KM/L:Float:90",
    COALESCE(bkd.repair_cost, 0.0) AS "Maintenance Cost:Currency:120",
    COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0) AS "Direct OpEx:Currency:120",
    (COALESCE(fl.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(bkd.repair_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0)) AS "Total Operating Cost:Currency:140",
    COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) AS "Invoiced Revenue:Currency:130",
    (COALESCE(rev.invoiced_revenue, 0.0) - (COALESCE(fl.fuel_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(bkd.repair_cost, 0.0) + COALESCE(opex.vehicle_opex, 0.0))) AS "Net Contribution:Currency:130"
FROM `tabVehicle` v
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        mt.vehicle,
        COUNT(mt.name) AS trip_count,
        SUM(IFNULL(mt.net_weight_tons, 0.0)) AS total_tons
    FROM `tabMining Trip` mt
    WHERE mt.docstatus = 1 
      AND mt.trip_status IN ('Approved', 'Delivered')
      AND (mt.is_test_record = 0 OR mt.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
    GROUP BY mt.vehicle
) t ON t.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        fl_sub.vehicle,
        SUM(IFNULL(fl_sub.quantity_litres, 0.0)) AS total_litres,
        SUM(IFNULL(fl_sub.total_fuel_cost, 0.0)) AS fuel_cost,
        ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fl_sub.is_full_tank = 1 AND fl_sub.km_per_litre > 0 THEN fl_sub.km_per_litre ELSE NULL END), 2) AS avg_kml
    FROM `tabFuel Log` fl_sub
    WHERE fl_sub.docstatus = 1 
      AND fl_sub.approval_status = 'Approved'
      AND (fl_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR fl_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fl_sub.fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fl_sub.fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY fl_sub.vehicle
) fl ON fl.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        vb_sub.vehicle,
        SUM(IFNULL(vb_sub.total_repair_cost, 0.0)) AS repair_cost
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown` vb_sub
    WHERE vb_sub.docstatus = 1 
      AND vb_sub.repair_status IN ('Repaired', 'Closed')
      AND (vb_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR vb_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR vb_sub.breakdown_datetime >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR vb_sub.breakdown_datetime <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
    GROUP BY vb_sub.vehicle
) bkd ON bkd.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        oe_sub.vehicle,
        SUM(IFNULL(oe_sub.posted_amount, 0.0)) AS vehicle_opex
    FROM `tabOperational Expense` oe_sub
    WHERE oe_sub.docstatus = 1 
      AND oe_sub.accounting_status = 'Posted'
      AND (oe_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR oe_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR oe_sub.expense_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR oe_sub.expense_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY oe_sub.vehicle
) opex ON opex.vehicle = v.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        v_id,
        SUM(inv_amt) AS invoiced_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            si.custom_vehicle AS v_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(si.base_grand_total) ELSE si.base_grand_total END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND si.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND si.custom_vehicle != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii_sub 
              WHERE sii_sub.parent = si.name AND sii_sub.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND sii_sub.custom_vehicle != ''
          )
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            sii.custom_vehicle AS v_id,
            CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -ABS(sii.base_net_amount) ELSE sii.base_net_amount END AS inv_amt
        FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
        JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
        WHERE si.docstatus = 1
          AND sii.custom_vehicle IS NOT NULL AND sii.custom_vehicle != ''
          AND (si.custom_is_test_record = 0 OR si.custom_is_test_record IS NULL)
    ) v_rev
    GROUP BY v_id
) rev ON rev.v_id = v.name
WHERE (v.is_test_record = 0 OR v.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR v.name = %(vehicle)s)
ORDER BY v.name ASC

name: Driver Performance
query:
SELECT
    d.name AS "Driver ID:Link/Driver:140",
    d.full_name AS "Full Name:Data:150",
    d.status AS "Status:Data:100",
    COALESCE(t.total_trips, 0) AS "Total Trips Assigned:Int:120",
    COALESCE(t.delivered_trips, 0) AS "Delivered Trips:Int:110",
    COALESCE(t.total_tonnage, 0.0) AS "Total Tonnage (Tons):Float:130",
    COALESCE(fl.total_km, 0) AS "Distance Driven (KM):Int:130",
    COALESCE(fl.total_litres, 0.0) AS "Fuel Consumed (L):Float:120",
    COALESCE(fl.avg_kml, 0.0) AS "Avg KM/L:Float:90",
    COALESCE(bkd.breakdowns, 0) AS "Breakdowns Encountered:Int:140"
FROM `tabDriver` d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        mt.driver,
        COUNT(mt.name) AS total_trips,
        SUM(CASE WHEN mt.trip_status IN ('Approved', 'Delivered') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_trips,
        SUM(CASE WHEN mt.docstatus = 1 THEN IFNULL(mt.net_weight_tons, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_tonnage
    FROM `tabMining Trip` mt
    WHERE mt.docstatus != 2
      AND (mt.is_test_record = 0 OR mt.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
    GROUP BY mt.driver
) t ON t.driver = d.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        fl_sub.driver,
        SUM(IFNULL(fl_sub.distance_travelled_km, 0)) AS total_km,
        SUM(IFNULL(fl_sub.quantity_litres, 0.0)) AS total_litres,
        ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fl_sub.is_full_tank = 1 AND fl_sub.km_per_litre > 0 THEN fl_sub.km_per_litre ELSE NULL END), 2) AS avg_kml
    FROM `tabFuel Log` fl_sub
    WHERE fl_sub.docstatus = 1
      AND (fl_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR fl_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR fl_sub.fuel_date >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR fl_sub.fuel_date <= %(to_date)s)
    GROUP BY fl_sub.driver
) fl ON fl.driver = d.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        vb_sub.driver,
        COUNT(vb_sub.name) AS breakdowns
    FROM `tabVehicle Breakdown` vb_sub
    WHERE vb_sub.docstatus != 2
      AND (vb_sub.is_test_record = 0 OR vb_sub.is_test_record IS NULL)
      AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR vb_sub.breakdown_datetime >= %(from_date)s)
      AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR vb_sub.breakdown_datetime <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
    GROUP BY vb_sub.driver
) bkd ON bkd.driver = d.name
WHERE (%(driver)s IS NULL OR %(driver)s = '' OR d.name = %(driver)s)
  AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR %(status)s = '' OR d.status = %(status)s)
ORDER BY d.name ASC

name: Trip Operations Summary
query:
SELECT
    mt.name AS "Trip ID:Link/Mining Trip:140",
    mt.dispatch_date_time AS "Dispatch Time:Datetime:140",
    mt.return_date_time AS "Return Time:Datetime:140",
    mt.vehicle AS "Vehicle:Link/Vehicle:120",
    mt.driver AS "Driver:Link/Driver:130",
    mt.mine_site AS "Mine Site:Link/Mine Site:140",
    mt.trip_status AS "Trip Status:Data:110",
    COALESCE(mt.tare_weight_tons, 0.0) AS "Tare (Tons):Float:90",
    COALESCE(mt.gross_weight_tons, 0.0) AS "Gross (Tons):Float:90",
    COALESCE(mt.net_weight_tons, 0.0) AS "Net Tons:Float:90",
    CASE 
        WHEN mt.return_date_time IS NOT NULL AND mt.dispatch_date_time IS NOT NULL 
        THEN ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, mt.dispatch_date_time, mt.return_date_time) / 60.0, 2)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS "Cycle Time (Hrs):Float:110",
    CASE 
        WHEN mt.net_weight_tons > 0 THEN 'Confirmed'
        ELSE 'Pending'
    END AS "Weighbridge:Data:100",
    COALESCE(mt.billing_status, 'Unbilled') AS "Billing Status:Data:110",
    COALESCE(mt.sales_invoice, '-') AS "Sales Invoice:Data:150"
FROM `tabMining Trip` mt
WHERE mt.docstatus != 2
  AND (mt.is_test_record = 0 OR mt.is_test_record IS NULL)
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR mt.dispatch_date_time <= CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59'))
  AND (%(vehicle)s IS NULL OR %(vehicle)s = '' OR mt.vehicle = %(vehicle)s)
  AND (%(driver)s IS NULL OR %(driver)s = '' OR mt.driver = %(driver)s)
  AND (%(mine_site)s IS NULL OR %(mine_site)s = '' OR mt.mine_site = %(mine_site)s)
  AND (%(trip_status)s IS NULL OR %(trip_status)s = '' OR mt.trip_status = %(trip_status)s)
  AND (%(billing_status)s IS NULL OR %(billing_status)s = '' OR mt.billing_status = %(billing_status)s)
ORDER BY mt.dispatch_date_time DESC
